description: Search volume estimated from clickstream data (real user search behaviour, not Google Ads ranges) for up to 100 keywords: average monthly searches and optional 12-month history, in 94 countries, from clickstream panel data, $0.04 a call. Use when Google Ads volumes look bucketed or you want a second estimate. Keywords under 3 characters are listed in missing. Bad input is a free 400; a data source failure is not charged. Price: $0.04 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base); pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, used when locationCode is absent (uk = gb).

includeMonthly.description: Add each keyword's monthly search volumes.

keywords.description: Keywords (1-100; each 3-80 characters; one that cannot be looked up is listed in missing).

locationCode.description: Location code of a country (2840 = United States, 2826 = United Kingdom, 2276 = Germany, ...; the /docs table). Default 2840.

name: clickstream_search_volume
title: Clickstream search volume (up to 100 keywords)
